youtube.title: Why sunflowers use the golden angle 🌻 #shorts
youtube.description:
Each new seed turns by the same angle. A simple fraction of a turn gives straight arms with gaps. The golden angle, 137.5°, never lines up, so the seeds pack perfectly.
